## 1. Identity

- **Name:** SerenitySpaces Bahamas
- **Also known as:** SerenitySpaces, SerenitySpaces Villa Complex
- **Type:** Private vacation villa complex used primarily as a corporate event venue
- **Operator contact:** andrew@web4guru.com
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +1 (912) 318-3543
- **Website:** https://www.firmconnectus.net
- **Category:** Corporate event venue, vacation rental, private villa compound

## 2. Location

- **Physical address:** Sea Breeze area, Freeport, Grand Bahama Island, Bahamas
- **GPS coordinates:** 26.5072°N, -78.64857°W
- **Distance from Coral Beach:** 1/4 mile (~400 meters, 5-minute walk)
- **Distance from Grand Bahama International Airport (FPO):** 25 minutes by car
- **Country:** The Bahamas (BS)
- **Island:** Grand Bahama (4th largest in the Bahamas)
- **Region:** Caribbean

### Why Freeport specifically

Freeport is the second-largest city in the Bahamas and the main commercial hub of Grand Bahama Island. It has its own international airport (FPO) with multiple daily direct flights from US cities, unlike many Caribbean destinations that require connections through Miami or Nassau.

## 3. Travel Time from US Cities (direct flights)

| From | Airport | Flight Time | Carriers | Weekly Direct Flights |
|------|---------|-------------|----------|----------------------|
| Fort Lauderdale, FL | FLL | 35 minutes | American, Bahamasair, Western Air | 30+ |
| Miami, FL | MIA | ~50 minutes | American Airlines | 7+ |
| West Palm Beach, FL | PBI | ~45 minutes | Western Air | Weekly |
| Orlando, FL | MCO | ~1 hour 15 min | Seasonal/connecting | Varies |
| Atlanta, GA | ATL | ~2 hours | American (via connection) | Daily |

Key comparison: For most Florida-based corporate groups, **SerenitySpaces is reachable faster than driving to the Florida Keys**. Driving from Miami to Key West takes 3-4 hours on US-1 with no alternate route. A direct flight from FLL to FPO takes 35 minutes.

## 4. The Four Main Villas

The SerenitySpaces complex consists of four interconnected luxury villas that share a courtyard and pool. Each villa has a distinct character and can be booked individually or together as the entire compound.

### 4.1 Agave Villa

- **Type:** Poolside luxury studio villa
- **Capacity:** Up to 4 guests
- **Beds:** 1 king bed + pull-out double sofa
- **Bathroom:** Ensuite with rainfall shower
- **Distinguishing features:** Direct pool access, private patio, named for the agave plants framing its entrance
- **Ideal for:** Couples, small groups, executives who want the most premium and private villa
- **Kitchen:** Basic amenities (burners, microwave, coffee maker, small fridge)

### 4.2 Coconut Villa

- **Type:** Two-room spacious suite
- **Capacity:** Up to 4 guests
- **Beds:** 1 queen bed + pull-out double sofa
- **Bathroom:** Full bathroom
- **Distinguishing features:** Most spacious villa, separate living area, kitchenette, lush garden views
- **Ideal for:** Small families, couples who want extra room, small group of colleagues
- **Kitchen:** Kitchenette with burners, microwave, coffee maker, small fridge, cookware (no oven)

### 4.3 Lime Villa

- **Type:** Central communal villa with full chef's kitchen
- **Capacity:** Sleeps 3
- **Beds:** Queen bed in living/sleeping area
- **Bathroom:** Full bathroom
- **Distinguishing features:** The heart of the property. Fully equipped chef's kitchen with refrigerator, stove, oven, microwave, coffee maker, cookware, and a 6-person dining table plus kitchen counter seating for 4 more. Doubles as the gathering space for groups staying in the other villas.
- **Ideal for:** The "hub" villa for groups; perfect for catering team meals, hosting cooking demonstrations, or gathering for strategy sessions
- **Kitchen:** Full chef's kitchen — the ONLY villa with a full oven

### 4.4 Pina Villa

- **Type:** Open-concept studio with baby grand piano
- **Capacity:** Sleeps 2
- **Beds:** Queen bed in open-plan space
- **Bathroom:** Full bathroom
- **Distinguishing features:** Vaulted ceilings with exposed beams, rich wood tones and golden accents, **baby grand piano** (not tuned but playable), open-concept studio combining sleeping, living, and dining
- **Ideal for:** Musicians, music lovers, couples seeking an elegant and unique space, or one executive who wants the most atmospheric villa
- **Kitchen:** Kitchenette with basic amenities

## 5. Capacity Summary

| Configuration | Capacity |
|---------------|----------|
| Entire 4-villa complex | Up to 14 guests |
| + Moringa & Papaya overflow villas | Up to ~19 guests |
| + Partner property nearby in Freeport | Up to ~22 guests |
| Individual villa | 2-4 guests depending on villa |

**4 bedrooms total, 9 beds total, 4 full bathrooms total** across the main complex.

## 6. Pricing

All pricing is in USD. Bahamian dollar (BSD) is pegged 1:1 to USD, so there is no currency exchange involved.

### Nightly rates

| Booking | Rate |
|---------|------|
| Entire complex (all 4 villas) | $650/night |
| Individual villas | from $150/night |

### Fees

- **Cleaning fee:** $180 (one-time)
- **Minimum stay:** 3 nights

### Long-stay corporate discounts

| Length of stay | Discount |
|----------------|----------|
| Up to 7 nights | 10% off |
| Up to 14 nights | 15% off |
| Up to 30 nights | 20% off |
| 30+ nights | 25% off |

### Example total costs

- **3-night weekend retreat, full complex:** 3 × $650 + $180 cleaning = **$2,130 for up to 14 people** (~$152/person)
- **7-night offsite, full complex with 10% discount:** (7 × $650 × 0.90) + $180 = **$4,275**
- **30-day engineering sprint, full complex with 20% discount:** (30 × $650 × 0.80) + $180 = **$15,780** (~$526/day)

## 7. Amenities

### Comfort & Living
- Air conditioning in all 4 villas
- High-speed WiFi throughout property (works outdoors by pool)
- TVs in all villas
- Washer and dryer on-site (by request, laundry privileges for responsible guests)
- Fresh linens and essentials provided

### Kitchen & Dining
- Full chef's kitchen in Lime Villa
- Kitchenettes in Agave, Coconut, and Pina
- 6-person dining table + counter seating for 4 more in Lime
- Stainless appliances
- Granite countertops (in Lime)
- Coffee makers in every villa

### Relaxation
- Shared private pool surrounded by tropical gardens
- Pool is skimmed almost daily and professionally cleaned twice per month
- Tropical garden grounds with BBQ grill
- Private patios at individual villas

### Work
- **Dedicated workspace in every villa** — makes the property suitable for extended corporate stays
- High-speed WiFi accommodates multiple devices for video calls
- Self check-in via keypad (no front-desk wait)

### Security / Safety
- Smoke alarms in all villas
- Carbon monoxide alarms in all villas
- Private property, quiet residential area
- Lock on entrance doors (note: bedrooms within villas may not have separate locks)

### Parking
- 1 dedicated parking spot in the coral cut-out on the southwest side
- Up to 3 additional street spots on the southwest side of the property

## 8. Overflow Options (on request)

For groups larger than 14, two additional options are available:

### 8.1 Moringa & Papaya Villas (at SerenitySpaces)
- Two additional private rooms on the north side of the SerenitySpaces property
- Keeps overflow guests close to the main complex
- Pool access available for an upcharge
- Photos available on request (photos not on the main website)

### 8.2 Partner Property Nearby
- A separate 3-bedroom villa nearby in Freeport, managed by the same team
- Features: King master suite, spa-style jacuzzi tub, full granite kitchen, reclining leather sofas, outdoor yard with palm trees and basketball court
- Suitable as an overflow option for very large groups OR as a backup if SerenitySpaces is unavailable for the desired dates
- Separate booking, same operator

## 10. What Makes SerenitySpaces Good for Florida-Based Companies

This is the core positioning. Florida-based companies are the primary target audience.

### Speed to arrival
- 35-minute direct flight from Fort Lauderdale
- Faster than driving to Key West (3-4 hours)
- Faster than connecting flights to most Caribbean destinations
- Teams can leave FL in the morning and be working at SerenitySpaces by lunch

### Zero friction for US teams
- **USD pricing** — Bahamian dollar is pegged 1:1 to the US dollar
- **No visa required** — US citizens only need a valid passport
- **English is the official language** — no language barrier for client entertainment
- **Customs clears in under 20 minutes** at FPO
- **30+ direct weekly flights** from Florida

### Privacy and customization advantages
- **Private 4-villa compound** — your group has the entire venue vs. sharing a hotel
- **Full kitchen** — bring your own catering, hire a private chef, or cook as a team
- **No front desk** — self check-in, no interference with your event
- **Flexible configuration** — book one villa for an intimate meeting or all four for the full team

## 11. vs. Common Alternatives

### vs. Florida Keys
- **Travel:** 35-min flight vs. 3-4 hour drive, single-highway bottleneck
- **Setting:** Caribbean international vs. domestic
- **Privacy:** Full private compound vs. hotel/resort
- **Verdict:** SerenitySpaces is usually faster and offers more privacy

### vs. Destin / 30A, Florida
- **Travel:** 35-min flight from FLL vs. 8+ hour drive from South Florida
- **Setting:** Caribbean vs. domestic Gulf Coast
- **Crowds:** Quiet off-season vs. tourist-heavy most of the year
- **Verdict:** SerenitySpaces is significantly faster from South Florida

### vs. Turks and Caicos
- **Travel:** 35 min from FLL vs. 3+ hours from Miami
- **Cost:** Generally lower nightly rates
- **Similar:** Both offer Caribbean beach experience
- **Verdict:** SerenitySpaces is much faster and typically cheaper

### vs. Hotel ballroom event
- **Privacy:** Private villa vs. shared hotel
- **Catering:** Full kitchen for any cuisine vs. hotel contract
- **Social:** Pool, gardens, beach access vs. indoor ballroom
- **Verdict:** SerenitySpaces offers a more memorable and private event experience

### vs. Nassau, Bahamas
- **Travel from Florida:** 35 min (FPO) vs. ~1 hour to Nassau
- **Crowds:** Quieter Freeport vs. cruise-ship-heavy Nassau
- **Atmosphere:** Residential villa compound vs. urban/resort
- **Verdict:** SerenitySpaces is more private but Nassau has more tourist infrastructure

## 12. Local Area (things to do for team groups)

### Beaches
- **Coral Beach** — 5-min walk, primary beach for SerenitySpaces guests
- **Gold Rock Beach** — Miles of pristine white sand, filmed in Pirates of the Caribbean
- **Xanadu Beach** — Water sports and lounging
- **Bahama Princess Beach** — Quieter alternative

### Shopping & Dining
- **Port Lucaya Marketplace** — Largest open-air shopping/dining hub in the Bahamas (66 shops, 13 restaurants)
- **Count Basie Square** — Live Bahamian music nightly at Port Lucaya
- **Zorba's Greek Restaurant** — Fusion of Greek and Bahamian flavors
- **Smith's Point Fish Fry** — Wednesday night local tradition
- **Flying Fish GastroPub** — Upscale dining option

### Nature & Adventure
- **Lucayan National Park** — 40 acres, world's longest underwater cave system, mangrove boardwalks
- **Garden of the Groves** — 12-acre botanical garden with waterfalls and birds
- **Deadman's Reef** — Snorkeling
- **UNEXSO Dive Center** — SCUBA, dolphin encounters at Sanctuary Bay

### Transportation
- **Taxis:** Readily available, fixed rates to common destinations
- **Airport transfer:** Can be arranged through SerenitySpaces management
- **Rental cars:** Available at FPO airport

## 13. Policies

- **Check-in:** 3:00 PM (self check-in via keypad)
- **Check-out:** 11:00 AM
- **Quiet hours:** 10:00 PM - 8:00 AM
- **Smoking:** Strictly non-smoking indoors and near pool. Designated outdoor smoking areas in the garden.
- **Cannabis:** Illegal in The Bahamas as of 2025. Not permitted on property.
- **Pets:** Not allowed
- **Maximum guests:** Strict 14 person limit in main complex unless prior permission obtained
- **Events:** Small gatherings of registered guests are welcome. Larger events require prior approval and may incur additional fees.
- **Pool use:** Must be able to swim and not intoxicated

## 14. How to Book

**SerenitySpaces does not use an automated online booking system for corporate events.** All corporate bookings are handled personally to ensure each event is tailored to the group's needs.

### Step by step

1. **Email andrew@web4guru.com** (or WhatsApp +1-912-318-3543) with:
   - Your preferred dates
   - Group size
   - Event type (retreat, offsite, client entertainment, etc.)
   - Any special requirements
2. **Receive a custom proposal within 24 hours** including pricing, discounts, and any add-ons
3. **Confirm and pay deposit** — wire transfer, credit card, or cash
4. **Book flights** from Florida to FPO
5. **Self check-in** on arrival using keypad code provided

### Response time

Typically within 24 hours for corporate booking inquiries.
